verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. The first equation is stated verbatim: fastAtIndex / fastDerivative is exactly c_{i_0}N_{i_0} (the chart coefficient T_g^{i}Q^{1+h} times the derivative along vector .temporal = v_t), Δv is temporalAtIndex / desiredIncrement, and E_θ^∘ is TemporalMeanUpdate.centered fθ, so temporalAtIndex_fast_cancellation and desiredIncrement_fastDerivative read c_{i_0}N_{i_0}Δv = −E_θ^∘. The second equation needs one transposition and one naming step: the Lean states c_{i_0}N_{i_0}Δγ + E_z^∘ = −c_{i_0}N_{i_0}(𝒜_1γ_d) (axialUpdate_fast_residual), and axialUpdate_eq_desired_sub_alias fixes Δγ = γ_d − 𝒜_1γ_d, so the paper's a = −𝒜_1γ_d = −axialAlias; moving E_z^∘ to the right-hand side gives the paper's form exactly. temporal_mean_update bundles both equations in one statement. Both Lean theorems add the standing hypotheses 0 < a < b, 0 < d, smoothness, torus periodicity and radial support of the source.
